race.comment: LITTLE KHAN (7) makes her debut off the back of a very impressive trial win, and her connections will be chasing the QTIS bonus attached to this race. The blinkers are on for the first time, and the in form David Vandyke stable rarely visit this course, unless they are confident of coming away with a win. Follow the market in on this filly. WHISKEY AND ROSE (12) is another promising filly making her debut with a couple of strong trial efforts under her belt. If not too green around this tricky circuit, then she can make her presence felt. IT'SALL ABOUT MARY (6) was beaten by a wide draw at the Sunshine Coast 11 days ago, and with a far better gate this time, she can finish a lot closer. Include in all combos to be safe. CATFISH (1) folded up after having a tough trip in front at the Sunshine Coast last start, and he may get an uncontested lead here from a handy gate, or even take some cosy cover. Ash Butler sticks with him, and so do we. WHIP 'N NEIGHNEIGH (14) must be kept safe.
